text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Takarazuka Kinen!! Yaeno, 
who's running with me, gave me a fired-up 
declaration that I'm a "worthy opponent" 
and a "rival"!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Chiyono O called me her "rival" too...!! 
She said she'd show me through her running 
what it feels like to chase a "dream"...!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Plus, Inari-senpai, true to her Edo 
spirit, took my challenge head-on! It got 
me super fired up, I tell ya!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
My roommate City is super fired up to go 
all out and win today's big race, too!! 
Nghhhhh~~!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I'm so thrilled to have this many rivals!! 
I'm gonna give it everything I've got!
